title: Swell the Anthem, Raise the Song
description: Swell the Anthem, Raise the Song in Tonic Solfa to PLEYEL'S HYMN, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 881 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Thanksgiving”, where the book credits them to the Sacred Lyrics.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to PLEYEL'S HYMN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Swell the an-them, raise the song; Prais-es to our God be-long; Saints and an-gels, join to sing Prais-es to the Heav-enly King.

lines: Swell the anthem, raise the song;
Saints and angels, join to sing
Kept by him, no foes annoy;
Hark! the voice of nature sings
Praises to the King of kings;
Let us join the choral song,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to PLEYEL'S HYMN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
